digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI scheduling — CodeQL workflow
propositions: CodeQL workflow scheduled cadence was weekly (23 4 * * 1) as a backstop for advisories, but after push-on-main trigger was removed it became the primary scan of newly-landed code, leaving findings unscanned for up to 7 days
CodeQL cadence must shift from weekly to 6-hourly (35 */6 * * *) to restore intended coverage parity with the original push-on-main behavior and reduce worst-case exposure from 7 days to 6 hours
The stale comment asserting CodeQL should not join the 6-hourly tick and citing 28x cost increase is false, because navapbc/rebar is public and CodeQL/Actions minutes are free
The four 6-hourly lanes (test.yml :41, optionality.yml :47, verify-identity.yml :53, codeql.yml :35) must use distinct off-the-hour minutes to avoid scheduler congestion
CodeQL has no push trigger and cannot join the _SIX_HOURLY tuple wholesale; it requires a separate schedule-only 6-hourly cohort while retaining no-push and workflow_dispatch cover
Test coverage in test_ci_main_push_policy.py must retarget CodeQL to the new 6-hourly cadence and add staggering invariant assertions, without deleting existing no-push or workflow_dispatch coverage
